The shower tray isn’t deep enough nor the glass screen big enough which means the bathroom floor becomes flooded if you don’t put loads of towels down. This doesn’t bother me but does result in a heavier work load for the cleaners. The area is beautiful with lots of restaurants and bars. The locals are friendly, and wasn’t over charged once in local shops. On the day of the wedding I realised I had forgotten to get my clothes pressed and the hotel staff rushed my shirt and trousers through their laundry service, with only an hour to go they got my clothes back to me in emmaculate condition. Would definitely stay here again!
